messages:
maya: FYI hitting a weird failure in SAST gate for a refactor. The scanner flags a UX serializer as hardcoded-secret-like pattern. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9210

leo: Can you paste the CI snippet? sometimes the scanner catches regex-like strings in tests.

maya: snippet:
```
[sast] high: possible hardcoded secret at ui/serializer.go:128
serializer.go:128: const exampleToken = "token-12345" // test data only
```

anita: Please attach the scanner JSON to the PR and add label `security:needs-evidence`. Sec-bot will copy artifacts if label is present.

maya: tried to attach but got permission denied when the pipeline attempted to write to the evidence bucket (403). Error mentions KMS decrypt failure.

infra-team: that sounds like the CI runner role missing kms:Decrypt on the CMK protecting s3://redwood-security-evidence. We intentionally restricted decrypts.

david: We can add a scoped grant for the pipeline action `attach-evidence`. Proposal: an IAM condition on the pipeline service account where attribute `action` equals `attach-evidence`, allow kms:Decrypt and s3:PutObject for the evidence bucket. Will add audit log entries on grant creation.

maya: that constraint sounds good. Two follow-ups: 1) we need the pipeline to copy compiled test binary sometimes for forensic validation (not just JSON). 2) audit log must record which PR and who approved the evidence attach.

anita: Agreed. Sec-bot should add an X-Evidence-Event header in the artifact metadata with a correlation id (ev-9210-1739991122) and the PR number. Also require approval from someone with `security:approver` to enable the attach job.

sec-bot: automation suggestion: when label `security:needs-evidence` is added, create draft evidence bundle: {json, build-metadata, optional-binary}. Require `security:approver` sign-off via PR review to proceed. On sign-off, run cp job with temporary KMS grant and emit CloudAuditLog entry `evidence.attach` with correlation id.

leo: tiny nit: retention policy for evidence bucket currently 90 days. For incident investigations we often need 180 days. Can we make it configurable per-bundle? e.g., evidence/<pr>/<ev-id>/metadata.json includes retention-days and infra enforces a max of 365.

infra-team: we'll implement per-bundle TTL metadata and enforce upper bound. Changing default to 180 days for security evidence. CR opened: CR-2026-91.

david: I'll review the conditional KMS policy to ensure it doesn't allow decryption broadly. We'll tighten key policy to accept decrypt only when the request includes the correct evidence correlation header.

maya: thanks. I'll update the PR with a suppression justification template for test-only secrets and link to the evidence bundle once the flow is live.

anita: one more governance ask: record RBAC changes in the same audit sink as evidence events. If someone changes pipeline roles, we need an immutable timeline.

infra-team: noted. We'll sink IAM changes + CloudAuditLog events to the security audit bucket and link to ev-id.

maya: sounds good. I'll wait for CR approval before re-running the attach job. Thanks folks. :thumbsup:
